sn48.45:1.2: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātupāsāde || || 2.
sn48.45:1.4: Katinnaṃ nu kho bhikkhave indriyānam bhavitattā bahulīkatattā khīnāsavo bhikkhu aññaṃ vyākaroti || ||
sn48.45:1.5: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyā ti pajānāmī ti || ||
sn48.45:2.2: Ekassa kho bhikkhave indriyassa bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu aññaṃ vyākaroti ||
sn48.45:2.4: Katamassa ekassa indriyassa || || 4. Paññāvato bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa tadanvayā saddhā saṇṭhāti || tadanvayaṃ viriyaṃ saṇṭhāti || tadanvayā sati saṇṭhāti || tadanvayo samādhi saṇṭhāti || || 5.
sn48.45:2.5: Imassa kho bhikkhave ekassa indriyassa bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā khīnāsavo bhikkhu aññaṃ vyākaroti || ||
sn48.45:2.6: Khīnā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāmī ti || || 1.
